title: Compute a Claude child's host admission (control plane and tracker reads) under the same state lock as its approval mode
outcome: One control_request of a Claude child is classified from one snapshot of state: the approval mode, the delegation-child flag, the control-plane capability and the tracker-read admission are read under one lock, so a delegation that completes or changes mode between reads cannot pair a read-only mode with a stale admission.
acceptance: The four facts are read under one state lock for each control_request, and the reader's comment about never seeing a torn pair covers all of them.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and diff hash cited in a note.
